description: Sets the message a banned user sees (`bannedMessage`) and the one a terminated user sees (`terminatedMessage`), replacing the previous text; "" puts Neblla's default back. At least one of the two is required. A banned user reads it above a form to write to the developer; a terminated one has no form, so its message should not point at one.

bannedMessage.description: New message shown to banned users

terminatedMessage.description: New message shown to terminated users

name: neblla_ban_settings
title: Ban settings
